title: Dr. Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi participated in the Health & Wellness Conclave organised by Social Talks on 20th March 2021 in Dehradun.
bodyHtml: Dr. Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi participated in the Health & Wellness Conclave organised by Social Talks on 20th March 2021 in Dehradun. This conclave was supported by the Indian Pharmacopeia Commission, United States Pharmacopeia, Indian Drug Manufacturers Association & National Chamber of Pharmaceutical Manufacturers of Sri Lanka. Conclave was inaugurated by Sh. Ganesh Joshi, Hon'ble Cabinet Minister of the Uttarakhand Government. During the conclave Dr. Raghuvanshi delivered a talk on 'IPC's Role for Ensuring Quality and Promoting Rational Use of Antimicrobials in India'. Participants from AIIMS, IIT Roorkee, Pharma Industries and Universities attended the conclave.
